cases.description: A yaml data fence inside a list item right after a section heading is part of the list, not the data block, so the section has no fields.
A heading line inside an HTML block, which runs from <div> to the next blank line (CommonMark 0.31.2, 4.6), starts no section and is part of $body.
An HTML block opened by <details> ends at the first blank line (CommonMark 0.31.2, 4.6), so a heading after that blank line is a section even though it renders inside the details element.
